title: 16.35. Sekkhattika, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Sekkhaṁ hetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasekkho nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe nava …pe… āsevane cha …pe… avigate terasa.
Sekkhaṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naasekkho nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā nava …pe… āsevane cha …pe… avigate nava.
